name: Apartment Gerlos 183
beschreibung: Apartment Gerlos 183 is situated in a quiet part of Gerlos, close to the mountain cable cars. The holiday apartment is practically furnished and offers views of the surrounding mountains. Guests will find a fully self-contained unit with a kitchen and bathroom, ideal for self-catering. The surrounding area invites visitors to go hiking in summer and skiing in winter. Shops and restaurants are within easy walking distance.
